text: No-fee instant external transfers for consumers in both directions: outbound over the 'instant payment network' with automatic fastest-rail selection, and inbound pulls executed as a Request for Payment approved at the external bank (S003, S045, S082).

Consumer Request-for-Payment bill pay over RTP: billers push RfPs into the Bill Pay dashboard; customer pays instantly, schedules or dismisses with no fee or cutoff – a closed loop with U.S. Bank's own biller RfP product (S045, S061).
Unified 'Transfer & pay' information architecture across app and web (Zelle, Transfers, Pay bills, Wires & ACH, Deposit a check) with a public knowledge base documenting exact labels.

Small-business money movement inside ordinary online banking: single-payee ACH (standard/same-day), domestic & international USD wires, instant payments, Zelle tag/QR, plus the July 2026 Enhanced Payments subscription that cuts per-transaction fees (S053, S060).

Commercial dual-rail instant payments (RTP and FedNow, $10M per transaction on both per the Instant Payments API) with intelligent routing, RfP, Payee Choice multi-rail disbursements (RTP/Zelle/push-to-card/ACH/prepaid/check) and Pay Smart routing (S061-S063, S943, S957).

Strong exception transparency on Zelle: 14-day expiry/refund, explicit irrevocability acknowledgment, purple-Z and first-name recipient confirmation, OTP cancels transaction if unverified (S008, S012, S015).
Voice/text money movement via Smart Assistant in English and Spanish (S083).

Zelle send carries an explicit, well-worded APP-scam interstitial ('Keep your money safe. Be sure this isn't fraud. U.S. Bank will never ask you to send money to anyone, including yourself…') with a mandatory irrevocability checkbox before every payment, plus review and 'Payment sent' screens that state expected delivery time and offer 'Save transaction details' (S901).

Digital wires are protected by a mandatory one-time passcode after Submit on top of the Wire Transfer Authorization attestation; future-dated wires editable/cancelable until 11:59 p.m. CT the day before (S902, S923).

Bill pay 'Let us find your bills' auto-discovers billers from credit-report and merchant-network data; U.S. Bank bills can be funded from an external bank account; stop-payment on bill-pay checks is self-service in-app (S908, S951, S952).

Public Digital Explorer library (digitalexplorer.usbank.com) documents nearly every money-movement flow screen-by-screen, including ATM and business banking, and is refreshed continuously (Zelle send 2026-09, split 2026-08, mobile deposit 2026-08, business videos Apr–Nov 2026).

Instant Payments API lets commercial clients choose TCH RTP, FedNow or let the bank route ('Instant'), with RfP send/cancel and webhooks — among the few banks exposing both rails to clients programmatically (S943).

Small business digital ACH and wires enforce owner-level dual control for multi-owner businesses: payments wait for a second owner, all owners are emailed with deadlines and outcomes, and statuses show 'needs approval' / 'co-owner approved' (S980–S983).
Commercial wires expose Swift GPI status updates in SinglePoint (S984); SinglePoint ACH auto-applies NOCs to templates and supports adjustment requests (S974).

Consumers cannot send international wires digitally (branch or phone only) and have no remittance/cross-border transfer product; the only consumer FX capability is ordering foreign cash in the mobile app (S005, S050, S956).

Digital wires require ≥6 months tenure, an eligible checking, savings or money market account and a registered cellular device (≥3 business days); unauthorized digital wires are only reimbursed 'at the bank's sole discretion' under Digital Security Coverage (S005, S017, S926).

Scam reimbursement stance is a single hedged sentence ('qualifying imposter scams may be eligible for reimbursement') with no public criteria; all Zelle disputes/scam reports are phone-only – no in-app claim path (S002, S011, S021).
Bill pay: customer cannot choose electronic vs check delivery; edits locked within 3 business days of the scheduled date (S038, S007).

Legacy navigation labels persist on marketing pages ('Pay bills & transfer', 'Bill payments > Pay bills & U.S. Bank accounts', 'Pay & transfer') versus the current 'Transfer & pay' – signals IA debt (S001, S096).

Mobile check deposit status is app-only; guidance on retaining checks is inconsistent (2 vs 7 business days) and first-time Zelle deposit timing is stated inconsistently (1–2 bd vs 3 bd) (S006, S007, S029, S030).
Bank pages disagree on the external-transfer edit/cancel cutoff (before 7 a.m. CT on the send day per KB0069523 vs 11:59 p.m. CT the day before per KB0070154) (S948, S949).
Consumer wire fee amount is still not published online (only 'shown before you confirm'); wire limits are visible only after entering full recipient details (S922, S921).
Business-specific Zelle guidance has been retired (KB0180664 → 404) without a replacement; business Zelle limits remain unpublished (S919).
The Apple App Store listing exposes only the latest release note; dated money-movement release history 2025–2026 cannot be reconstructed from the store (S937).
Warren 2022 staff report: U.S. Bank refunded about 29% of unauthorized-transaction Zelle claims (8,242 of 28,642; under $4.7M of over $16.2M), 2021–H1 2022 [S966].

CFPB 2023 consent order (ReliaCard prepaid unemployment cards): alleged 2020 account freezes and, in some cases, failure to provide provisional credit after unauthorized-transfer reports; U.S. Bank said the freeze prevented >$375M of fraud [S968].
Zelle requesters are not told when a request is ignored or declined without a message; requests silently expire after 30 days (S970).
Bank pages still disagree on the FedNow per-transaction limit: real-time payments page says $1 million, Instant Payments API says $10 million (S061 vs S943).

Small-business dual control is owner-based only (multi-owner businesses; S980–S983); it is not documented for instant payments, and there is no documented maker-checker between a delegate user and an owner (S930, S934, S936).
Inbound instant external transfer implemented as an RTP Request for Payment to the customer's other bank (S045).
Consumer-facing RfP bill pay (U.S. Bank was an early RfP biller bank, Nov 2021) (S045, S113).
Free next-day inbound ACH option alongside standard and instant (S075).
Enhanced Payments: transparent SMB fee menu (ACH $0.50, same-day ACH $1.70, domestic wire $16, international wire $35, instant $0.75 for $25/month) (S053).
Zelle tag and QR for small business receivables; Zelle Disbursements and Visa Direct push-to-card for commercial payouts (S054, S062, S068).
Smart Assistant voice initiation of transfers, P2P and bill payments (S083).
Instant payment speed offered inside the ordinary small-business ACH send flow ('instant, standard, or same day') with transparent per-payment fees (S912).
ATM main menu includes 'Transfers & payments' (account-to-account transfers and card/line-of-credit payments) and multi-format receipts (Email / Print / Print & email) (S954, S911).

Treasury API catalogue of 20+ money-movement APIs incl. Disbursements via Zelle enrollment check, Payee Choice, Push to Card ($125k, 30-minute funding) and FBO virtual accounts for embedded payments (S942, S944, S941).

July 8 2026 – Enhanced Payments launched for small businesses ($25/mo; lower ACH/wire/instant fees; batch ACH; payee templates; international wires now digital); new transaction limits and money-movement chooser for all business online-banking users (S060, S053).

Oct 27 2026 – Google Play release: streamlined direct-deposit enrollment, home value in net worth, enhanced transaction search (S085); the undated store description also says mobile deposit is 'now with increased limits'.
June 2 2026 – Digital payments scam page updated; Fraud Liaison Center positioned as scam intake (S012).
Aug 29 2025 – 'All-in-one cash flow management platform' (bill pay for business) launched; Standard/Pro plans; $250 enrollment bonus through Jan 13 2027 (S117, S047).
Aug 6 2025 – Paze page updated; Paze offered since Sept 2024 for cardholders and merchants (S064, S114).
March 31 2025 – Zelle standalone app retired; U.S. Bank splash page directs all users to enroll through the bank app (S020, S002).
Consumer 'Instant transfer' option for external transfers (no fee) and RfP-based inbound instant transfers documented in KB (dates not stated) (S082, S045).

Nov 2 2026 – Digital Explorer 'Tour of business online banking' video published: Transfer & pay tab centralises pay bills, ACH, wires, instant payments and Zelle with 'no additional logins or subscriptions necessary'; U.S. Bank invoicing (card or bank-account payments) promoted (S917).
Oct 23 2026 – iOS app v3.0.8441: streamlined direct-deposit enrollment, home-value in net worth, enhanced transaction search (S937).
Oct 15 2026 – 'User management' for business online banking promoted (money-movement permissions per user; 'constantly adding new account types and permissions') (S915).

Sep 9 2026 – 'Send money with Zelle®' demo republished with the current two-screen scam warning and 'Payment sent' confirmation (S901); Aug 25 2026 split-the-bill demo ($1,000 cap, 10 people) (S904); Jul 17 2026 request-money demo (S903).
Apr 2026 – Business videos 'Send an ACH' (instant/standard/same-day speeds), 'Send a wire transfer', 'Compare ways to pay', 'Selecting a new Level 1 user' published (S912–S914, S916).
2026 – SinglePoint earned Celent 2026 Model Bank for Cash Management (S938).
Nov 2 2026 – U.S. Bank (US BANK, NA) listed in the Federal Reserve FedNow participating financial institutions list (S955).
Oct 19 2026 – Payment Switch launched: move recurring bills/subscriptions to a U.S. Bank debit or credit card from the mobile app's Bills & Subscriptions dashboard (Atomic) (S959).
Sept 2025: CFPB terminated the Dec 2023 U.S. Bank ReliaCard consent order >3 years early, waiving alleged noncompliance [S968].
Nacha Phase 1/2 fraud-monitoring rules effective Mar 20 / Jun 19, 2026 [S969].
Whether consumer outbound 'Instant transfer' rides RTP, FedNow or both, and whether U.S. Bank is a FedNow send participant for consumer flows.
Consumer domestic wire fee amount, wire transaction limits (KB0130961) and whether OTP/step-up is applied to wires and one-time external transfers.
Zelle scam reimbursement criteria beyond 'qualifying imposter scams'.
Union Bank (Dec 2022 close; 2023 conversion) product effects – no fetched page referenced Union Bank migration of money-movement products; not verified.

Consumer domestic wire: OTP after Submit now CONFIRMED (S902) and limits KB captured (S920/S921), but the fee amount is still unpublished online and OTP on one-time external transfers remains undocumented.

Whether consumer 'Instant transfer' and SMB 'instant' ACH speed ride RTP, FedNow or bank-routed 'Instant' – consumer/SMB pages never name the network (S947, S912); only the commercial API exposes the choice (S943).
External-transfer cancel cutoff conflict between KB0069523 (7 a.m. CT same day) and KB0070154 (11:59 p.m. CT day before).
Instant Payments API transaction status catalogue (behind developer login) and iOS version history 2025–2026.
Union Bank conversion effects: production transition pages are retired; FSG PDF text not extractable.
UNRESOLVED (USB-C015): standard outbound external transfer timing – 1–3 business days (Transfer money page, KB0070109) vs 2–3 business days (KB0250043); bank pages conflict.
Coverage gap (USB-C006): commercial AP Optimizer®, virtual credit card payables and U.S. Bank prepaid disbursements are marketed (S960) but not inventoried or mapped.
Coverage gap (USB-C007): U.S. Bank invoicing for small business (card or bank-account collection, S917) not inventoried; rails and flow unknown.
Do the small business co-owner approval rules (KB0200937) apply to digital international wires and to instant payments? KBs say 'digital wire' and 'ACH payment' only.
Is the retired business Zelle KB0180664 (still on the uat3 mirror) superseded by a new article, and are business Zelle dollar limits different from consumer limits?
FedNow limit conflict: real-time-payments page ($1M) vs Instant Payments API ($10M).
